level=3 is the full solution. Taking it costs nothing but the one campaign-wide achievement for never looking, so the host should present it plainly rather than as a penalty.

Sent on every check, passing or not. The host needs failures too: it offers hint level 1 on its own after a first failed attempt, and cannot do that if only successes are reported. failed=0 is always followed by task_done.

sig is required. It guards against a double-fired check, not against cheating - anti-cheat in ring 0 is a fiction. hinted=1 means the player opened the full solution, which only affects the one campaign-wide achievement for never looking.

_open_questions: The Bible achievement was written against /Misc/Bible.TXT.Z. The file in the snapshot is Misc/Bible.TXT, uncompressed, so the detector needs fixing.
The guest RX FIFO is 256 bytes, which fits exactly one 240-byte command. The protocol therefore has to be strictly command -> ACK.

Hooks with verified=false need either an edit under Adam/ or a live function override. The override route is preferable: it leaves the stock OS untouched, and redefining a kernel function while it runs is itself one of the things the campaign teaches.
